paired_fixed_truth_drift_progress.bound_scope: Exact coordinate-wise logical bounds conditional on accepted labels, fixed dated truth, identity and candidate availability. Cross-query identity consistency can constrain attainable population combinations; no population point estimate.

paired_fixed_truth_drift_progress.personal_action_scenario: Additionally requires dated new personal action by the deceased person; excludes retrospective reporting/posthumous publication as answers. This stricter interpretation is not established as ICEWS coder semantics.
paired_fixed_truth_drift_progress.benchmark_soundness_scenario: All existing exact-date benchmark positives also assumed worldtrue; independent external-only scenario does not require this.
